direction_notes: Mean ADC fell 4.9% after TUS in the TUS group (13 rats), significant in 6 of 8 ROIs; sham-surgery group (6 rats, no TUS) unchanged.
safety_notes: Maximum temperature rise estimated analytically at about 1e-4 degC; no tissue assessment reported.

exposures.label: Transcranial US to whole rat head, 800 kHz

target.label: caudate putamen region and middle brain motor-related region

timing.protocol_description: 'The ultrasound duration and the interstimulus interval were 10 and 100 ms, respectively', applied for 5 min through the skull with an unfocused transducer 2 mm above the gel-coated skull. Whether 10 ms is the pulse or a train, and the PRF, are not stated.
